text:
alex: beginning staged rollout for flux-proxy v1.9.0-hotfix. plan 2% -> 8% over 25m. change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. target region ap-southeast-1. rollout id rl-2026-03-21-03

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-03 started: routing 2% traffic to v1.9.0-hotfix (service=proxy).

tess: smoke tests running. watching p95/p99 and 5xx.

miko: noticing spike in 502s on ap-southeast-1c nodes, small sample but consistent. posting logs.

miko: log excerpt:
```nERR: upstream 502 bad gateway host=upstream-auth ap-southeast-1c
CONNS: open 210 -> 431 in 60s
```

alex: hold expansion at 2%. please collect upstream traces and check LB health. ops-runbook-bot suggestions?

ops-runbook-bot: recommended actions: 1) pause rollout 2) apply per-shard pin to previous version 3) capture upstream trace. pause/pin/rollback templates:
pause: `deployctl rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-21-03 --reason "hold: upstream 502s ap-southeast-1c"`
pin: `routingctl pin --service proxy --to-version v1.8.9 --shard ap-southeast-1c`
rollback: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-03 --to-version v1.8.9 --confirm`

deploy-bot: pause request received from alex. executing pause...

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-03 paused at 2% (user: alex). state=PAUSED. note="hold: upstream 502s ap-southeast-1c"

tess: running targeted smoke against ap-southeast-1c and collecting upstream traces now.

miko: initial traces show upstream-auth returning 502s under medium fanout. creating ticket INFR-2457 and assigning infra-oncall.

alex: quick vote: pin shard to v1.8.9 and keep rollout paused globally? react with :+1: to pin, :-1: to keep investigating without pin.

tess: :+1: pin

miko: :+1:

alex: pin approved. applying routing pin.
deploy-bot: routingctl: pin applied -> service=proxy shard=ap-southeast-1c -> version v1.8.9. routing change id rc-10022.

deploy-bot: rollout remains PAUSED. no automatic increments will occur.

alex: added changelog note: "paused flux-proxy v1.9.0-hotfix due to upstream 502s in ap-southeast-1c; pinned shard to v1.8.9 while infra investigates (INFR-2457)."

ops-runbook-bot: rollback snippet:
```n# global rollback to stable
deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-03 --to-version v1.8.9 --force --confirm
```

infra-oncall (bot): INFR-2457 acknowledged. investigating upstream-auth capacity and connection handling. ETA 35m for first update.

alex: status set to PAUSED_PINNED. owner=alex. keep channel updated; we'll resume only after infra signoff and green smoke+gold prompt checks.
